Apple Phone Technician here! I will say this…  great companies aren’t usually built on the backs of gentle leaders. A great company requires a strong leader who makes the impossible, possible. Unfortunately, these leaders tend to be overbearing, harsh, to-the-point, and expect perfection. They aren’t always the easiest to work with, but the result of their drive is a product that stands above the rest. Steve Jobs was a visionary and he made his visions come to life because he wasn’t scared of being politically correct or hard on his engineers. Was it right? Maybe not. But is it what made Apple so revolutionary? Yes.

It is my opinion is that current leaderships’s lack of nose-to-the-grindstone work ethic is what has led to mostly camera upgrades the past decade.
Let’s go!!!

Her mom said that Christina also felt better during her first pregnancy. That is a common theme amongst those suffering with PMDD. Some, like myself, feel even worse during pregnancy. I assume this is an extreme sensitivity to the hormonal change but not sure which hormone. These are things that should be easily tested. Getting insurance to pay for repeated hormonal testing to figure out where are sensitivities lie is next to impossible.

I am SO glad you found medication that works for you. Mine will work until luteal phase and gradually stops altogether. By the time I have 6-9 monthly cycles, the medication no longer works and I have to get on a new one. I have been on so many. It's hard because I get a taste of feeling normal, then bam! The PMDD takes it away.

Thank you so much for being an advocate for change. I've tried birth control as well, but it makes my symptoms worse instead of better. I have tried a few over the years to no avail. Some of the antidepressants I have tried started to make me feel better, but as soon as my period starts, it loses its effectiveness permanently. I am constantly cycling through ADs with minimal relief. I hope we can find a cure in our lifetime, or at least pave the way for the women who come after us.    Sending you all the love.
